selected_story: Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk) open weights released for download
headline_th: Mistral Large 4 เปิดให้ดาวน์โหลดน้ำหนักโมเดลแล้ว
takeaways_th: ดาวน์โหลดโมเดลไปรันเองได้
เด่นด้าน Coding Agent และความปลอดภัยไซเบอร์
บริการ Model-as-a-Service ต้องขอไลเซนส์
fact_notes: The MODEL was first announced in preview on 2026-10-06; the OPEN WEIGHTS were released 2026-10-29. Do not claim a newly announced model on 2026-11-02.
Mistral says the model is natively multimodal, roughly one trillion total parameters, intended for coding/agents and defensive cybersecurity.
Weights can be downloaded from Hugging Face and self-hosted with sufficient resources. Open-weight is not unconditional open-source licensing.
Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight license allows broad use but operating a model-as-a-service business requires separate Mistral commercial license.
Published model performance benchmarks are provider-reported, not a universal quality guarantee.
